status: execution protocol fixed before multi-source estimates
domain: One common radius, calibrated on a dense reference geodesic disk; audit boundary angular resolution and ODE separately. Source polygons approximate the same disk. If they disagree, use one common dense polygon and global spatial triangulation.
historical_comparison: Reconstruct documented RK4 and restricted descendant selection; not byte-identical replay, because the original full driver is absent.
global_refinement: At each iteration compare centroid parent against four centroid children for EVERY active parent; refine parents accounting for 80% of summed local normalized error. No restriction to descendants of initially selected cells.
concentration_measure: Area-weighted: order cells by K^2, use intrinsic-area quantiles and fractional-cell interpolation. R_eff=(integral K^2 dA)^2/(area*integral K^4 dA).
legacy_cell_metrics: Descriptive only. Not invariant under nonuniform subdivision. Not directly comparable to the area-weighted estimands.
inference_scope: Numerical audit of supplied checkpoint; not population inference or causal evidence.
area_calibration: B6 DOP853 dense rays, degree-5 area7 on 32 radial rings; Brent root xtol=1e-13; abs(A/0.02-1)<=1e-6
mesh: same fixed boundary polygon, varying interior seeds, scipy Delaunay; exact polygon coverage checks as B6

classification.PASS: All six sources internally converged, valid common domain, no numerical exception; C_A relative range <0.005 and original B6 concentration gates all pass
classification.FAIL: Six valid internally converged sources but one or more frozen cross-source gates fails
classification.INCONCLUSIVE: Missing source, exception, invalid geometry/domain, or internal convergence not achieved at frozen stopping limits

reuse_policy: B7 cases reused in B8. B6 split6 true six-source 2048 results may be reused explicitly; representative 8192 result never mixed into the 2048 population.
calibration_bracket: upper=0.09; if area<0.02 expand by factor 1.25, maximum 12 brackets, before Brent root; no retuning of tolerances
B8_primary: Fresh execution of split6 true at 2048, six sources; retain B6 as reference only
